ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; dominated by low-intensity pixels (approx. 92-95%) with localized high-intensity white clusters (approx. 5-8%) primarily at the distal tips and scattered on the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity region across entire visible fluke surface; high-contrast white geometric blobs (mottling/scars) located at distal tips and two distinct circular spots on the left lobe mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression at central convergence with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees; lower apex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary; right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes of approximately 10-25 pixels; left lobe shows similar jaggedness but is partially angled away from the focal plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe displays a broad convex curve on the trailing edge; left lobe displays an elongated, straight-to-slightly-convex sweep tapering toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters; two distinct spots located on the medial-lateral area of the left lobe; dense white clusters present on the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, sub-parallel diagonal linear disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, representing lighter-intensity rake marks against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified white protrusions (barnacles) localized on the distal tips and along the right trailing edge; multiple circular depigmented scars across the blade surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white-water spray and droplets create transient pixel noise across the lower fluke boundary and central surface area.
